                fsync_dir(link.parent)
            elif temp_link.is_symlink() and os.readlink(temp_link) == str(dest):
                temp_link.unlink()
            raise

def inventory(root):
    result = {}
    for folder, dirs, names in os.walk(root, followlinks=False):
        for name in dirs + names:
            p = Path(folder) / name
            relative = p.relative_to(root).as_posix()
            if relative == 'control_config.json':
                continue
            s = p.lstat()
            meta = (stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode), s.st_uid, s.st_gid)
            if stat.S_ISLNK(s.st_mode):
                result[relative] = ('link', os.readlink(p), meta)
            elif stat.S_ISDIR(s.st_mode):
